analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, representing 35% year-on-year growth, alongside an EBITDA of ₹89 crore. Despite initial operational challenges caused by raw material supply constraints and geopolitical disruptions in West Asia, the company expanded its complex fertilizer product portfolio and achieved improved EBITDA margins. Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of over ₹500 crore across the remaining quarters of FY27 as raw material availability normalizes and capacity utilization ramps up. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with quarterly revenue growing 34.58% year-on-year to ₹532.3 crore and Profit After Tax increasing 53.88% to ₹47.06 crore. Management highlighted that expanded capacities at Meghnagar-including NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA-are progressively contributing to results.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve 30% to 35% turnover growth over the previous year as production from its expanded capacity normalizes.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company targets achieving a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence in building on current momentum through the remainder of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon revival in early July led to a rapid acceleration in Kharif sowing across the company's primary marketing zone.
demand_outlook.quote: This pivot has triggered a massive acceleration in Kharif growing across our primary marketing zone.

demand_outlook.claim: Higher Minimum Support Prices announced for mandatory Kharif crops are expected to enhance farmer purchasing power and support fertilizer application.
demand_outlook.quote: These revisions will directly strengthen farmgate economics, enhance purchasing power, and support optimal fertilizer application rates.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government backing through the NBS framework create a favorable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry with comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, bringing total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating potential capacity expansion opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: The 70,000 MTPA green ammonia capacity tied up under an agreement with SECI will commence operations in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly EBITDA reached ₹89 crore in Q1 FY27, representing a 36% year-on-year increase.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margins average around 7% to 8% for trading and approximately 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has passed on approximately 25% to 30% of input cost increases to customers through higher subsidy support and price revisions.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Lower-cost inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to higher EBITDA margins in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, capacity utilization stood at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 89,747 metric tonnes of fertilizers during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for Q1 FY27 stood at 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, reducing the share face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Depreciation rose to ₹13 crore and finance costs increased to ₹20 crore following the commissioning of new plant capacity.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars, including disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

risks_headwinds.claim: West Asia shipping disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz led to increased freight, delayed vessel movements, and higher procurement costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices escalated from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material availability was the primary operational constraint during the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include market conditions, regulatory changes, competitive pressures, and technological advancements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include market conditions, regulatory changes, competitive pressures, and technological advancements.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover run-rate exceeding ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve 30% to 35% turnover growth over the previous year as capacity utilization improves.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia supply agreement with SECI is scheduled to begin delivering capacity in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.
